# IT Service Desk Incident Resolution Ticket INC-84091
User Support Resolution Log

## Ticket Summary
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Ticket ID | INC-84091 |
| Date Logged | 04/14/2026 08:42 EDT |
| User | Marcus Vance (Finance Dept, Ext. 4118) |
| Workstation | Dell Latitude 7440 (Asset #FIN-0982) |
| Docking Station | CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt 4 (Asset #DCK-0441) |
| Operating System | Windows 11 Enterprise 23H2 |
| Primary Issue | Dual 4K external monitors showing No Signal; USB mouse unresponsive |

## Diagnostic Steps & Findings
- Connected workstation directly to AC power; laptop screen functions normally.
- Verified dock front indicator LED was solid white, confirming power brick output.
- Cable inspection showed Thunderbolt host cable plugged into dock USB-C front data-only port.
- Relocated host connection cable to rear Thunderbolt 4 upstream port labeled with computer icon.
- Peripheral status: USB optical mouse and wired keyboard immediately recovered functionality.
- Display settings check: Windows Display Properties detected both Dell U2723QE displays at 3840x2160 @ 60Hz.

## Action Taken and User Guidance
- Relocated physical host cable to the correct upstream connection port on the rear panel.
- Advised user to replace the dual external monitors due to hardware failure.
- Verified firmware on CalDigit TS4 is version 39.1; no update required.
- For permanent resolution, please submit a replacement request through the IT portal.
- Case marked Resolved on 04/14/2026 at 09:15 EDT by Tier 1 Tech R. Davies.

errors.quote: Advised user to replace the dual external monitors due to hardware failure.
errors.explanation: The diagnostic findings clearly state that Windows Display Properties detected both external monitors at full resolution (3840x2160 @ 60Hz) once the dock was cabled properly, contradicting the conclusion that the monitors suffered hardware failure and need replacement.
errors.fix: Advised user that both external displays are operating normally and no hardware replacement is required.

errors.quote: For permanent resolution, please submit a replacement request through the IT portal.
errors.explanation: The instruction references submitting a request through the IT portal but omits the mandatory portal URL or specific form catalog link required for the employee to complete the action.
errors.fix: For permanent resolution, please submit a replacement request through the IT portal at https://servicedesk.internal.net/catalog/hardware.
